property_summary: For any caller that is the current owner and any newOwner address, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) completes successfully (does not revert) and sets c.owner() == newOwner; the mutant that unconditionally sets owner = address(0) will violate this for some newOwner values (e.g. newOwner != address(0)).
change_summary: Replace the assignment in transferOwnership with an assignment that sets owner to the zero address, which may revert when called by non-owner due to modifier but changes behavior when allowed.
